description: Control a Keenetic router: devices, Wi-Fi, VPN routing, segments, safe verified writes.
name: io.github.salatmaster/keenetic-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Router address on the LAN, for example 192.168.1.1. Optional: `npx keenetic-mcp init` discovers it from the default gateway and stores it.
environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Router login. Optional, defaults to admin.
environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_USER

environmentVariables.description: Router password. Optional: the setup wizard stores it in the operating system keychain instead. Use this in a container, where there is no keychain.
environmentVariables.name: KEENETIC_PASSWORD
